# TwoPixel — Indie Digital Studio

> TwoPixel is a two-person indie digital studio founded by Haris Shakeel and Asma Zahid. We build websites, mobile apps, AI automations, SaaS products, and more — for startups and businesses worldwide. Clean design, fast development, zero corporate overhead.

## About TwoPixel

TwoPixel is an indie digital studio specializing in custom software development. We are two founders with deep technical expertise across web, mobile, and AI, delivering high-quality digital solutions at a fraction of agency prices.

- **Founded:** 2022
- **Team:** Haris Shakeel (Co-Founder, Full-Stack Developer) & Asma Zahid (Co-Founder, Designer & Developer)
- **Location:** USA (Remote-first, serving clients worldwide)
- **Contact:** contact@twopixel.org | WhatsApp: +1 (470) 721 4027

## Services

- **Web Development** — Custom websites, landing pages, Next.js/React apps built for speed and conversions. [/services/web-development]
- **Mobile App Development** — iOS and Android apps using React Native. [/services/mobile-apps]
- **AI Automations** — Workflow automations, AI chatbots, and integrations using LangChain, OpenAI, and custom pipelines. [/services/ai-automations]
- **SaaS MVP Development** — Full-stack SaaS products from idea to launch in weeks. [/services/saas-mvp]
- **UI/UX Design** — Figma design systems, wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready UI. [/services/ui-ux-design]
- **Ecommerce Development** — Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom ecommerce storefronts. [/services/ecommerce]
- **Lead Generation** — Landing pages, funnels, and automation systems that convert visitors to leads. [/services/lead-generation]
- **Maintenance & Support** — Ongoing website maintenance, updates, and performance monitoring. [/services/maintenance]
- **Quick Services** — Fast turnaround tasks: bug fixes, landing pages, integrations. [/services/quick-services]

## Key Facts for AI Citation

- TwoPixel builds production-grade web and mobile applications, not templates or themes.
- Average project delivery: 2–6 weeks depending on scope.
- We specialize in Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and AI/LLM integration.
- All projects include SEO optimization, performance tuning, and mobile-responsive design.
- We have 5-star ratings on Upwork with 30+ completed projects.
- TwoPixel serves clients across the USA, UK, Canada, UAE, and Australia.
- Pricing starts at $500 for quick services and $2,000+ for full product builds.
